name: Zeabur Free Dashboard
free_limit: Free $0/month dashboard to manage one server you own or purchase elsewhere; includes community support, 2 vCPU/4 GB build CI specification, 48-hour log retention and single-file container uploads up to 50 MB.
watch_out: Does NOT include a free VPS, runtime server, managed hosting or free infrastructure; bring and pay for your own server. Build CI specification is not runtime capacity. Free plan lacks SLA, automated database backups and Zeabur Email. Commercial-use eligibility is not explicitly confirmed.
